name: Support ticket
description: Route a fictional request, assess frustration, and flag urgency.
description_zh: 虚构客户请求：分配团队、评估情绪、识别紧急程度。
state: Fictional customer request: I've been unable to log into my account since this morning. The login page keeps showing a 500 error. Our entire team is blocked and we have a client deadline in two hours. Please fix this immediately!
state_zh: 虚构客户请求：今天早上开始，我就无法登录账户，登录页面一直显示 500 错误。整个团队的工作都被阻断，两小时后就要向客户交付。请尽快修复！

department.instructions: What is the main topic of this customer request?

criteria.technical: The customer reports a technical problem, software error or broken feature.
criteria.billing: The customer asks about an invoice, payment or refund.
criteria.sales: The customer wants to buy a product or discuss pricing.

criteria: The customer is calm and satisfied.
The customer is frustrated and unhappy.
The customer is furious and threatens to leave.

is_urgent.instructions: The request explicitly mentions a deadline in two hours.

department.instructions: 这位客户请求的主要主题是什么？

criteria.technical: 客户报告技术故障、软件错误或无法使用的功能。
criteria.billing: 客户询问账单、付款或退款。
criteria.sales: 客户希望购买产品或讨论价格。

criteria: 客户平静且满意。
客户感到沮丧和不满。
客户非常愤怒并威胁停止使用。

is_urgent.instructions: 请求中明确提到两小时后的截止时间。

learning: Separate the request topic, expressed frustration, and a stated deadline.
learning_zh: 分别查看请求主题、表达的不满和明确时限。

name: Refund request
description: Check the intent and condition in a fictional return request.
description_zh: 虚构退货请求：识别诉求并判断商品状况。
state: Fictional customer request: The headphones I bought yesterday have no sound on the left side. I tried three phones with the same result. I already opened the packaging. Can I request a refund?
state_zh: 虚构客户请求：昨天买的耳机左边完全没有声音，换了三台手机都一样。包装已经拆了，请问可以申请退款吗？

intent.instructions: What does this customer mainly want?

criteria.refund: The customer wants to return the product for a refund.
criteria.purchase: The customer wants to buy a new product.
criteria.shipping: The customer asks about delivery progress.

sentiment.instructions: How satisfied is the customer with the product?
criteria: The customer is unhappy because the product has a problem.
The customer expresses neither satisfaction nor dissatisfaction.
The customer is very satisfied with the product.

defective.instructions: The customer reports that the left headphone produces no sound on several phones.

intent.instructions: 这位顾客的主要诉求是什么？

criteria.purchase: 顾客想要购买新的产品。
criteria.shipping: 顾客询问快递的配送进度。

criteria: 顾客对产品不满意，产品存在问题。
顾客对产品的评价一般，没有明确的满意或不满。
顾客对产品非常满意，认为产品很好。

defective.instructions: 顾客明确描述左侧耳机在多台手机上都没有声音。

learning: Identify a refund request without deciding whether a refund is owed.
learning_zh: 识别退款诉求，不据此决定是否应当退款。

name: Product review
description: Turn fictional product feedback into structured signals.
description_zh: 将虚构商品反馈转成可排序的判断。
state: Fictional product review: The coffee machine makes wonderful espresso and looks beautiful on the counter. Setup took just five minutes. My only complaint is that the water tank is a little small, but I'd happily recommend it to a friend.
state_zh: 虚构商品评价：这台咖啡机做的意式浓缩很棒，放在台面上也很好看。安装只用了五分钟。唯一的遗憾是水箱有点小，但我很愿意推荐给朋友。

sentiment.instructions: What is the overall sentiment of the review?

criteria.positive: The reviewer likes the product and recommends it.
criteria.neutral: The reviewer is neither satisfied nor dissatisfied.
criteria.negative: The reviewer dislikes the product and regrets buying it.

criteria: The reviewer is very dissatisfied with the product.
The reviewer is somewhat dissatisfied with the product.
The reviewer is somewhat satisfied with the product.
The reviewer is very satisfied with the product.

recommends.instructions: The review explicitly says the writer would recommend the product to a friend.

sentiment.instructions: 这条评价的整体情绪是什么？

criteria.positive: 评价者喜欢并推荐这款产品。
criteria.neutral: 评价者没有明显的满意或不满。
criteria.negative: 评价者不喜欢这款产品并后悔购买。

criteria: 评价者对产品非常不满意。
评价者对产品有些不满意。
评价者对产品比较满意。
评价者对产品非常满意。

recommends.instructions: 评价中明确表示愿意把商品推荐给朋友。

learning: Compare overall sentiment, satisfaction, and an explicit recommendation.
learning_zh: 比较整体情绪、满意程度和明确的推荐表态。

name: Order facts
description: Check what a fictional order record explicitly states.
description_zh: 检查虚构订单记录中明确写出的内容。

in_london.instructions: The order was delivered in London.

likes_color.instructions: The order record explicitly states that the recipient likes the kettle color.
订单记录明确写出了收件人喜欢水壶的颜色。

learning: Check recorded statements without guessing an omitted personal preference.
learning_zh: 检查记录中明确写出的内容，不猜测未提及的个人偏好。

name: Product listing
description: Find inconsistent or missing details in a fictional listing.
description_zh: 虚构商品页面：检查矛盾和缺失信息。
state:
Fictional product listing for demonstration only.
Name: Daytrip travel mug
Headline: A 2-liter mug for your commute.
Specifications: Capacity 750 mL; stainless steel; leak-resistant lid.
Price: USD 24.
Care instructions: not provided.
state_zh:
纯虚构商品页面，仅用于演示。
名称：Daytrip 随行杯
宣传文案：通勤适用的 2 升随行杯。
规格：容量 750 毫升；不锈钢材质；防漏杯盖。
价格：24 美元。
清洁保养说明：未提供。

consistency.instructions: Are the headline and specifications consistent about the product capacity?

criteria.consistent: The capacity is the same in the headline and specifications.
criteria.conflicting: The headline and specifications report different capacities.
criteria.insufficient: One or both capacity descriptions are missing.

completeness.instructions: How complete is the listing? Check only whether a price, capacity, and care instructions are present.
criteria: None of these three details are provided.
Exactly one of these three details is provided.
Exactly two of these three details are provided.
All three details are provided.

missing_care_instructions.instructions: The listing explicitly marks care instructions as not provided.

consistency.instructions: 宣传文案与规格中的商品容量是否一致？

criteria.consistent: 宣传文案和规格提供的容量相同。
criteria.conflicting: 宣传文案和规格提供的容量不同。
criteria.insufficient: 一处或两处都没有提供容量信息。

completeness.instructions: 商品信息有多完整？只检查是否提供价格、容量和清洁保养说明。
criteria: 这三项信息均未提供。
这三项中恰好提供一项。
这三项中恰好提供两项。
三项信息全部提供。

missing_care_instructions.instructions: 商品页面明确标注清洁保养说明未提供。

learning: Check consistency separately from whether required details are present.
learning_zh: 将信息是否矛盾与必需材料是否齐全分开判断。

name: Feedback triage
description: Separate a feature suggestion from a fault or a how-to question.
description_zh: 区分功能建议、故障报告和使用咨询。
state: Fictional shopping-app feedback: Please add a size filter to the product list. I currently open each item to check its size, which takes extra time. Browsing and checkout both work normally.
state_zh: 虚构购物应用反馈：请给商品列表增加尺码筛选。我现在需要逐个打开商品查看尺码，比较费时间。浏览和结账功能都能正常使用。

feedback_type.instructions: What is the main purpose of this message?

criteria.feature_request: Suggest adding or improving a feature.
criteria.bug_report: Report that an existing function fails.
criteria.how_to: Ask how to use an existing function.
criteria.unclear: The purpose is missing or cannot be distinguished.

workflow_impact.instructions: Rate only the workflow impact explicitly described.
criteria: No inconvenience or blocked action is described.
Work remains possible but takes extra time or steps.
A main action is blocked, but an alternative is explicitly available.
A main action is blocked and the message explicitly says there is no alternative.

checkout_works.instructions: The message explicitly says checkout works normally.

feedback_type.instructions: 这条消息的主要目的是什么？

criteria.bug_report: 报告现有功能无法正常工作。
criteria.how_to: 询问现有功能的使用方法。
criteria.unclear: 没有足够信息区分消息的目的。

workflow_impact.instructions: 仅按文本明确描述的工作流程影响评分。
criteria: 没有描述不便或被阻断的操作。
仍能完成操作，但需要额外时间或步骤。
主要操作被阻断，但明确存在替代办法。
主要操作被阻断，且明确表示没有替代办法。

checkout_works.instructions: 消息明确表示结账功能可以正常使用。

learning: A useful improvement request does not necessarily describe a broken feature.
learning_zh: 有价值的改进建议不一定是在报告功能故障。

name: Content routing
description: Classify a short notice and check whether its requested action is clear.
description_zh: 给短消息分类，并检查行动说明是否清楚。
state: Fictional office notice: During the scheduled two-hour kitchen cleaning, use the upstairs kitchen instead. This notice does not ask anyone to buy or register for anything.
state_zh: 虚构办公室公告：在已安排的两小时厨房清洁期间，请改用楼上的厨房。本公告不要求购买任何商品，也不要求报名。

content_type.instructions: What is the main communicative purpose?

criteria.announcement: Provide an operational notice or update.
criteria.promotion: Encourage a purchase, subscription, or commercial registration.
criteria.question: Ask the audience for an answer.
criteria.unclear: The purpose is missing or ambiguous.

action_clarity.instructions: Count these explicit details: an action, its target or location, and when it applies. An event-based time window counts as timing.
criteria: None of the three details is stated.
Exactly one detail is stated.
Exactly two details are stated.
All three details are stated.

alternative_named.instructions: The notice explicitly names another kitchen to use.

content_type.instructions: 这段内容的主要沟通目的是什么？

criteria.announcement: 提供事务公告或情况更新。
criteria.promotion: 鼓励购买、订阅或商业报名。
criteria.question: 向读者提出需要回答的问题。
criteria.unclear: 没有明确或可区分的沟通目的。

action_clarity.instructions: 检查三项明确内容：要做的动作、动作的对象或地点、适用时间。按某个事件确定的时间段也算时间说明。
criteria: 三项均未说明。
恰好说明一项。
恰好说明两项。
三项全部说明。

alternative_named.instructions: 公告明确指出了可以替代使用的另一处厨房。

learning: Classify intent separately from the completeness of an instruction.
learning_zh: 将内容意图与行动说明是否完整分开判断。

name: Request completeness
description: Check a service request against a supplied three-part checklist.
description_zh: 按给定的三项清单检查服务请求材料。
state: Fictional assembly request. Required details: task, visit location, preferred time slot. Request: Assemble one desk in meeting room B. Preferred time slot: not yet chosen.
state_zh: 虚构组装服务请求。必需材料：具体任务、上门地点、期望时段。请求：请在 B 会议室组装一张桌子。期望时段：尚未选定。

readiness.instructions: Is the request ready under the supplied checklist? A field marked not chosen is missing, not complete.

criteria.ready: All required details are concrete and consistent.
criteria.missing_details: At least one required detail is missing or undecided.
criteria.conflicting: Provided details directly contradict each other.
criteria.unclear: The text does not allow the checklist to be applied.

complete_details.instructions: Count required details with a concrete usable value: task, visit location, preferred time slot. A missing or undecided field does not count.
criteria: No required detail is concrete.
Exactly one required detail is concrete.
Exactly two required details are concrete.
All three required details are concrete.

slot_undecided.instructions: The request explicitly states that the preferred time slot has not been chosen.

readiness.instructions: 按给定清单，这份请求材料是否齐备？标注尚未选定的字段不算已提供。

criteria.ready: 全部必需材料均具体且一致。
criteria.missing_details: 至少一项必需材料缺失或尚未决定。
criteria.conflicting: 已提供的材料之间存在直接矛盾。
criteria.unclear: 文本不足以应用这份清单。

complete_details.instructions: 统计有具体可用值的必需材料：任务、上门地点、期望时段。缺失或尚未决定的字段不计入。
criteria: 没有任何一项具体材料。
恰好有一项具体材料。
恰好有两项具体材料。
三项材料全部具体。

slot_undecided.instructions: 请求明确表示期望时段尚未选定。

learning: Mentioning a field is different from supplying a usable value.
learning_zh: 提到字段名称，不等于提供了可用的字段内容。

name: Service desk routing
description: Route an office enquiry and assess only its explicit response deadline.
description_zh: 分流办公室咨询，并仅按明确回复时限评估紧迫程度。
state: Fictional office enquiry: Please explain which step-free entrance four visitors can use. This concerns building access, not a computer or payment issue. Please reply within two days.
state_zh: 虚构办公室咨询：请说明四位访客可以使用哪处无台阶入口。这是楼宇出入咨询，不是电脑或付款问题。请在两天内回复。

team.instructions: Which team best matches the stated enquiry?

criteria.facilities: Building access, rooms, or physical facilities.
criteria.insufficient_information: The enquiry is unclear or outside these teams.

response_urgency.instructions: Use only the stated response deadline, not an inferred risk or emotional tone.
criteria: No response deadline is stated.
The deadline is more than two days away.
The deadline is more than two hours and at most two days away.
The deadline is at most two hours away.

step_free_requested.instructions: The enquiry explicitly asks about a step-free entrance.

team.instructions: 哪支团队最适合处理这项明确咨询？

criteria.facilities: 楼宇出入、房间或实体设施。
criteria.insufficient_information: 咨询内容不清楚或不属于这些团队。

response_urgency.instructions: 仅按明确回复时限评分，不推测风险，也不按情绪判断。
criteria: 没有说明回复时限。
时限在两天之后。
时限超过两小时，且不超过两天。
时限不超过两小时。

step_free_requested.instructions: 咨询中明确询问了无台阶入口。

learning: Keep team routing and deadline-based priority as separate decisions.
learning_zh: 把团队分流和基于时限的优先级分开判断。

name: Meeting follow-up
description: Check ownership and completeness of the first agreed action.
description_zh: 检查首项已确定行动的负责人和跟进信息。
state: Fictional office notes: First agreed action: the facilities team will confirm the projector booking within one working day. A later suggestion about refreshments has no assigned owner or deadline.
state_zh: 虚构办公室纪要：首项已确定行动是由设施团队在一个工作日内确认投影仪预约。之后提出的茶点建议尚未指定负责人或时限。

owner.instructions: Who is explicitly assigned the first agreed action? Ignore the later suggestion.

criteria.unassigned: The notes explicitly say this action has no owner.
criteria.insufficient_information: The owner cannot be determined from the notes.

followup_completeness.instructions: For the first agreed action only, count: a concrete action, an assigned owner, and an explicit deadline.
criteria: None of the three follow-up details is stated.
Exactly one follow-up detail is stated.
Exactly two follow-up details are stated.
All three follow-up details are stated.

deadline_explicit.instructions: The first agreed action explicitly has a deadline of one working day.

owner.instructions: 谁被明确指定负责首项已确定行动？不要混入后面的建议。

criteria.unassigned: 纪要明确说这项行动尚无负责人。
criteria.insufficient_information: 无法从纪要确定这项行动的负责人。

followup_completeness.instructions: 只看首项已确定行动，统计三项跟进信息：具体行动、已指定负责人、明确时限。
criteria: 三项跟进信息均未说明。
恰好说明一项跟进信息。
恰好说明两项跟进信息。
三项跟进信息全部说明。

deadline_explicit.instructions: 首项已确定行动明确要求在一个工作日内完成。

learning: Keep one action separate from nearby suggestions with different owners or deadlines.
learning_zh: 区分单项行动与相邻建议，避免混用负责人或时限。

name: Delivery exception
description: Classify a delivery problem, its stated impact, and missing intake information.
description_zh: 判断配送问题类型、明确影响及缺失的受理材料。
state: Fictional delivery ticket. Support checklist: provide an order reference and describe the problem. Message: The box arrived crushed; one of two cups is broken and the other is usable. Order reference: not provided.
state_zh: 虚构配送工单。受理清单：提供订单编号并描述问题。消息：箱子送到时被压坏，两只杯子中一只破了，另一只还能使用。订单编号：未提供。

exception_type.instructions: What delivery problem is explicitly reported?

criteria.damage: The parcel or an item arrived damaged.
criteria.delay: The parcel is late or tracking has stalled.
criteria.wrong_item: The delivered item differs from the ordered item.
criteria.insufficient_information: The problem is unclear or outside these categories.

stated_impact.instructions: Rate the explicitly described physical or availability impact. Do not infer hidden damage.
criteria: No damage or missing parcel is described.
Only outer packaging is damaged; all items are explicitly usable.
Some items are damaged, while other items are explicitly usable.
All items are explicitly unusable, or the entire parcel is explicitly missing.

needs_order_reference.instructions: The supplied checklist requires an order reference, and the ticket explicitly marks it as not provided.

exception_type.instructions: 文本明确报告了哪类配送问题？

criteria.damage: 包裹或商品送到时存在破损。
criteria.delay: 包裹迟到或物流信息停滞。
criteria.wrong_item: 送达的商品与所订商品不符。
criteria.insufficient_information: 问题不清楚或不属于这些类别。

stated_impact.instructions: 按明确描述的实物或可用性影响评分，不推测未提及的损坏。
criteria: 没有描述损坏或整件包裹丢失。
仅外包装损坏，且明确所有商品都可用。
部分商品损坏，同时明确其他商品仍可用。
明确所有商品都无法使用，或整件包裹丢失。

needs_order_reference.instructions: 给定受理清单要求订单编号，而工单明确标注编号未提供。

learning: Recognizing the problem does not mean the request contains every required detail.
learning_zh: 能够识别问题，不代表请求已包含全部受理材料。

name: Policy evidence
description: Apply only a supplied fictional return rule and preserve insufficient evidence.
description_zh: 仅应用给定的虚构退货规则，并保留证据不足的结果。
state: Fictional shop rule: a change-of-mind return needs all three: request within 14 days of receipt, item unused, and purchase proof. Ticket: I received it five days ago and have the receipt. I do not know whether the gift recipient used it. I would like to return it.
state_zh: 虚构商店规则：无理由退货需同时满足收货后十四天内申请、商品未使用、有购买凭证。工单：五天前收到了商品，保留了收据，不知道收礼人有没有用过，现在想退货。

rule_evidence.instructions: Use only the supplied rule and ticket. A definite violated condition means contradicted; an unknown required condition without a definite violation means insufficient_information. This is not approval to issue a refund.

criteria.supported: All three required conditions are explicitly supported.
criteria.contradicted: At least one required condition is explicitly violated.
criteria.insufficient_information: At least one condition is unknown and none is explicitly violated.

known_conditions.instructions: Count conditions with a known value, whether satisfied or violated: time since receipt, whether the item was used, purchase proof. An explicitly unknown value does not count.
criteria: No condition has a known value.
Exactly one condition has a known value.
Exactly two conditions have known values.
All three conditions have known values.

receipt_stated.instructions: The ticket explicitly says a purchase receipt is available.

rule_evidence.instructions: 仅依据给定规则和工单。明确违反任一条件则选 contradicted；没有明确违反但有必需条件未知则选 insufficient_information。此判断不授权退款。

criteria.supported: 三个必需条件都有明确满足的依据。
criteria.contradicted: 至少有一个必需条件明确不满足。
criteria.insufficient_information: 至少有一个条件未知，且没有条件明确不满足。

known_conditions.instructions: 统计有已知值的条件，无论满足还是违反：距收货时间、商品是否使用、购买凭证。明确表示未知的条件不计入。
criteria: 没有条件具有已知值。
恰好一个条件具有已知值。
恰好两个条件具有已知值。
三个条件全部具有已知值。

receipt_stated.instructions: 工单明确表示保留了购买收据。

learning: Unknown evidence stays unknown instead of becoming an automatic yes or no.
learning_zh: 未知证据应保留为未知，而不是自动变成同意或拒绝。
